Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

- `post_text()` now uses its own `tempfile::tempdir()` for each call. The parallel tests no longer share one path. `tempfile` is already a dev-dependency of `camcraft-app`, so there is no new dependency.
- The directory is removed when it goes out of scope, so the explicit `remove_file` is not needed.
- `expect` is in a test file only, which the Prime Directive permits.
- The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #4159`. The author comment has the Windows evidence (5 runs, 28 passed each).
